about_the_game:
The Aquarium – That Aquarium.
The one you had as a kid, dreamed of having, or just stood in front of with your nose against the glass. The one that makes you smile when you remember it.

The Aquarium is a cosy and relaxing game, you can build and decorate your aquarium. Buy, raise, and sell fish. Discover new species. And sometimes, just sit back and watch. Because, like any real aquarium, The Aquarium aims to bring peace and calm.

Raise fish, discover new species.
The Aquarium lets you explore new fish species based on your experience. Create the right environment and take care of them, watch them grow. You’ll follow their progress and learn what they need. You’ll also manage a small hobby budget as you go.

The Aquarium is cosy, fun, relaxing, and full of calm moments, a peaceful escape, whenever you need it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4330 (2 * 3500); AMD FX-4300 (4 * 3800)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950 (2048 VRAM); Radeon HD 7750 (1024 VRAM)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500(4 * 3800); AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (4 * 3100)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (2048 VRAM); Radeon R9 380 (2048 VRAM)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: The Aquarium is a relaxing game where you design your aquarium. Collect and raise fish, plants, and other aquatic life, then sell them. Discover new species and create The Aquarium! Sit back, relax, and enjoy the view.
